page_title: Capty — Screen Capture & Screen Recorder for macOS

sources.entry: Capty - Screen capture and recording tool with built-in editing and annotations.

summary.name: Capty
summary.one_liner: Capty is a macOS screen capture and screen recording app with a built-in editor for annotating, beautifying, and sharing screenshots and recordings.
use_cases: Recording screen with system audio and microphone
Extracting text from a screen area with OCR
Recording iPhone or iPad screens over a cable
summary.what_it_does: Capty takes screenshots in four modes: selected area, specific window, full screen, and automatic scrolling capture. Its editor offers annotation tools such as pen, highlighter, text, arrows, shapes, numbers, redact, and blur, plus backgrounds, frames, and shadows. It records the Mac screen or a cable-connected iPhone or iPad with system audio, microphone, and camera overlay, and includes cursor effects, zoom, and timeline trimming. Utilities include OCR text capture, QR scanning, capture history, and uploads to S3-compatible storage, and exports cover PNG, JPEG, MP4, MOV, and GIF.
notable: Records cable-connected iPhone and iPad as well as the Mac screen
Built-in editor with annotations, redaction, and beautified backgrounds
Works with S3-compatible storage such as AWS, Cloudflare R2, and DigitalOcean Spaces
Universal Binary for Intel and Apple Silicon
caveats: A paid one-time license is required after the 7-day free trial
Trial and license activation need an internet connection; cloud uploads also need one
